title: KU researchers awarded $10 million grant to advance sustainable chemical manufacturing
summary_en: A $10 million grant from the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation was awarded to a team of University of Kansas scientists to establish a research hub that will transform chemical manufacturing by developing fundamental design principles to make these products in a sustainable manner.
title_cn: KU researchers awarded $10 million grant to advance sustainable chemical manufacturing

title: KU Engineering to host 70th Annual Asphalt Paving Conference
summary_en: On Dec. 3, the University of Kansas Department of Civil, Environmental & Architectural Engineering will host experts in the field of asphalt paving engineering for a conference exploring the latest developments in the profession.
title_cn: KU Engineering to host 70th Annual Asphalt Paving Conference
